jobs.prompt: Bump the version from 1.167.0 to 1.167.1. In package.json and package-lock.json (both places in the lock: the top version and packages[""].version) change 1.167.0 to 1.167.1. In README.md change every 1.167.0 pin (kickoff text, tag name) to 1.167.1. In these tests replace the 1.167.0 pin with 1.167.1 where it is the current-version pin (assertions, test titles, the pin map in the AH release test): tests/t101-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lesson-t80-cli.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ag-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ah-release.test.mjs. In CHANGELOG.md add a NEW top entry ## 1.167.1 above the 1.167.0 entry (keep it unchanged) with the lead-in line: Held tickets no longer flood the owner's Needs you. And this bullet with a bold lead word: **Board:** a ticket an orchestrator deliberately held (blocked, not waiting on dependencies) is never a Needs-you item unless it carries a specific question (swarm tickets ID --set blocked --question TEXT); the orchestrator that held it owns releasing it. Then run those six tests and make them pass. Change nothing else.
